fact: Stats SA told Parliament's Appropriations Committee on 28 April 2026 that it has put in place, as a risk mitigation, the development of the National Strategy for Developmental Statistics to determine data gaps; the document gives no adoption date.
SADC Secretariat's re-advertised request of 25 November 2025 seeks an individual consultant, over 8 months, to develop a draft NSDS for South Africa.
